title: Padel Jam Enam
subject: four girlfriends on a six a.m. padel court in South Jakarta, three of them there for the photos and the narrator there to win
caption: Indonesian keyboard-led power pop in the Vierratale style, bright and quick. A grand piano hammering eighth-note chords as the main riff; a polysynth lead answering the vocal in short bright phrases; crunchy electric guitars opening up on the choruses; a punchy picked bass; tight live drums with handclaps on the bridge. Clean, glossy band production, piano up front, guitars wide. Female lead vocal, clear and bright in the mid register, chatty and teasing in the verses, belting the chorus. 136 BPM, A major. Bouncy, cheeky and competitive. No EDM drop, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no pop-punk palm-muting, no ballad breakdown.
lyrics:
[Intro - piano riff and drums]

[Verse 1]
Lapangan jam enam, disewa dua jam
Semua pakai rok putih, kayak seragam
Sepatu baru, labelnya belum dicopot
Yang lain sibuk cari angle buat story

[Pre-Chorus]
Aku nonton tutorial sampai jam dua pagi
Aku ke sini mau menang, bukan buat mejeng

[Chorus]
Padel jam enam, servis dari bawah pinggang
Bola mantul di kaca, kalian malah pose bareng
Padel jam enam, aku serius, beneran
Satu set dulu, abis itu terserah kalian

[Verse 2]
Skor dua-lima, Sasha masih pegang HP
Rina di seberang nanya filter yang bikin kaki jenjang
Dita sibuk benerin kuncir di depan kaca
Aku lari sendirian dari pojok ke pojok

[Pre-Chorus]
Tiba-tiba Sasha taruh HP di bangku
Oke, oke, ayo, sini bolanya

[Chorus]
Padel jam enam, servis dari bawah pinggang
Sasha smash keluar pagar, Rina sama Dita bengong
Padel jam enam, ujung-ujungnya kalah juga, sih
Tapi yang diposting malah fotoku pas jatuh

[Bridge - synth lead and handclaps]
Tiga ratus ribu sejam, dibagi berempat
Mahal, tapi kapan lagi lihat Sasha keringetan

[Outro - piano riff, drums stop]
Minggu depan jam enam lagi?
Boleh, tapi HP dikumpulin di tas
